title: Dense Structural Compression of Transformers via Gauge-Correct Channel Removal
abstract: arXiv:2609.07264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference energy per token drives the cost and carbon footprint of deployed transformers. It is dominated by dense matrix products that incur fused multiply-accumulate (FMA) operations and memory traffic. To reduce these computations while retaining dense tensors for high GPU throughput, we develop a methodology from first principles to adapt structural complexity during training to maximize inference utility per unit compute. Channel penalties drive entire tensor slices to zero to enable physical removal while preserving density and the network function.   The natural approach, penalizing the norm of operator components acting through each channel, is provably destabilized by gauge freedom. We resolve this pathology with GaugeLasso: additive symmetric group-lasso penalties that recover a monotone function of product-norms when the network converges to gauge balance. translated_title: 通过规范校正的通道移除实现Transformer的稠密结构压缩
translated_abstract: 每个token的推理能耗决定了已部署Transformer模型的运行成本与碳足迹，该能耗主要由稠密矩阵乘法产生，涉及融合乘加（FMA）运算和内存流量。为了在保留稠密张量以获得高GPU吞吐量的同时减少这些计算，我们从第一性原理出发开发了一套方法，在训练过程中调整结构复杂度，以最大化单位计算量下的推理效用。通道惩罚会将整个张量切片驱动至零，从而实现物理移除，同时保持张量的稠密性和网络功能。自然而直接的方法——对作用于每个通道的算子分量的范数施加惩罚——被证明会因规范自由度而不稳定。我们通过GaugeLasso解决了这一病态问题：一种加性对称的组套索（group-lasso）惩罚，当网络收敛至规范平衡时，能够恢复乘积范数的单调函数。我们的均衡分析使得逐通道校准能够正确地……
tldr: 提出GaugeLasso方法，通过规范校正的加性对称组套索通道惩罚，在训练中将Transformer的冗余通道驱动至零并物理移除，同时保持张量稠密性和网络功能，从而降低推理计算成本与能耗。
en_tdlr: Proposes GaugeLasso, an additively symmetric group-lasso channel penalty with gauge correction that drives redundant Transformer channels to zero for physical removal during training while preserving tensor density and network function, thereby cutting inference compute and energy costs.
